speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and decreased sensation in your right arm. To help me narrow down the cause, have you noticed if these symptoms started suddenly or did they develop gradually over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 55-year-old male bodybuilder. The patient has been experiencing weakness in his right arm for a few weeks, which has progressively worsened to the point of dropping objects. He also reports a recent unexplained weight loss of 17 pounds and has a history of diabetes. The patient admits to chronic alcohol use, heavy smoking, and anabolic steroid use.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Thoracic Outlet Syndrome (neurogenic type) due to anatomical compression from anabolic steroid-induced hypertrophy, exacerbated by smoking and alcohol use; consider cervical radiculopathy or brachial plexopathy given the progressive weakness and sensory loss.
